scope.supersedes: R21 detection study (read-only; its A/C conditional-design attribution is withdrawn and replaced by matched A/B/C descriptive interval-method contrasts)

interpretation: Descriptive finite-sample behavior on one registered instance. A/B/C are computed on common replicates. B/C contrasts channel propagation under matched percentile construction; A/B contrasts interval constructions; A/C remains mixed. No coverage pattern is a single-cause attribution or formal bias decomposition. Plug-in bias/RMSE are separate exact-truth simulation summaries. Logical-envelope containment is not statistical coverage; INDETERMINATE is an honest outcome. Rates describe this grid only.
